chunks: The hypocrites fear lest a Surah is revealed concerning them, exposing what is in their hearts. Say to them: 'Mock as much as you like; God will surely expose what you dread.'
ai.seo_question: What do the hypocrites fear regarding the revelation of Surahs in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah At-Tawbah, this verse highlights the psychological torment of the hypocrites who feared a specific revelation would expose their inner deceit, a theme emphasized by Shia exegetes like Al-Tabarsi who link it to the 'Surah of the Hypocrites' (Surat al-Munafiqun). The divine response, 'Say, go ahead and mock,' serves as a rhetorical challenge, assuring that God will ultimately extract them from their hiding places, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience over the hidden heart (qalb).
